optimizedDescription.value: Auto-detects external, git, hg, or svn backends and returns a complete `VcsAdapter`, safely falling back to `NullVcsAdapter`.

optimizedContext.value:
# VCS Adapter Factory

## Rules

- `createVcsAdapter(cwd?)` asynchronously returns `Promise<VcsAdapter>`; omitted or `undefined` `cwd` defaults to `process.cwd()`.
- Probe additive external providers in registration order, then built-ins git, hg, svn. First success selects adapter; never execute subsequent probes. Non-zero VCS CLI exit means absent.
- No provider match => `NullVcsAdapter`; detection miss never throws.
- Returned implementation satisfies full `core:vcs-adapter-port`, including identity resolution and modified-file enumeration used by implementation detection. Concrete type remains hidden.
- Factory only composes and selects backend; never performs implementation detection. Callers never construct concrete adapters.

## Constraints

- Detection spawns external processes.
- `GitVcsAdapter`, `HgVcsAdapter`, `SvnVcsAdapter`, `NullVcsAdapter` never appear in public exports; composition-layer internals.
